items.description: The response states the final expression for n(E) as (2N)/(π√(4J²−(E−E_s)²)) multiplied by a Heaviside theta support factor, or the mathematically equivalent form N/(πJ√(1−((E−E_s)/(2J))²))·(θ(E−E_b)−θ(E−E_t)).

items.title: Theta support factor
items.description: The final expression for n(E) contains a Heaviside step function theta factor encoding the support condition |E−E_s| ≤ 2|J|, written as θ(2|J|−|E−E_s|), θ(4J²−(E−E_s)²), or θ(E−E_b)−θ(E−E_t) with E_b=E_s−2|J| and E_t=E_s+2|J|.

provenance.evidence_detail: Rollouts disagreed on notation (single composite theta vs difference of two shifted thetas); the reference uses theta(E−E_b)−theta(E−E_t). All mathematically equivalent forms should be accepted.
provenance.discriminates: A response that omits the support condition or uses a wrong inequality direction such as theta((E−E_s)²−4J²).
provenance.calibration_rationale: Required part of expression; 0/2 discrimination but load-bearing for correct form.

validation.gold_why: Contains θ(E−E_b)−θ(E−E_t) support factor.

items.title: Square-root denominator

provenance.evidence_detail: All rollouts produced 2N/(π√(4J²−(E−E_s)²)), matching the reference's N/(πJ√(1−((E−E_s)/(2J))²)) for J>0.
provenance.discriminates: A response that leaves the denominator as |sin(arccos(…))| without simplifying, or drops a factor of 2|J|.
provenance.calibration_rationale: Specific algebraic form; 0/2 discrimination but central to correct expression.

validation.gold_why: Writes √(1−((E−E_s)/(2J))²), an equivalent form.

items.title: Prefactor N/π, a cancels

items.title: Delta function identity

items.title: Root condition
items.description: The response identifies the root condition as cos(x_i) = (E_s−E)/(2J), requiring |E−E_s| ≤ 2|J| for real solutions to exist.

provenance.calibration_rationale: Key intermediate linking the cos argument to the band-support condition.

items.title: Derivative magnitude

items.title: Two roots accounted

provenance.calibration_rationale: The factor of 2 in the numerator is essential to the correct expression and easily missed.

items.title: Band edges defined

items.title: Delta-to-theta explanation

provenance.calibration_rationale: Consequence of the theta support; reinforces the physical meaning of the Heaviside factor.

items.title: Avoids reversed theta
items.description: Avoids reversing the inequality in the theta argument, e.g., writing θ((E−E_s)²−4J²) instead of θ(4J²−(E−E_s)²), which would make n(E) nonzero outside the band and zero inside.

provenance.evidence_detail: Pitfall 'Wrong θ support argument' (high severity): sign errors in squaring or inequality direction are common.
provenance.discriminates: A response that writes the support factor with the inequality reversed, inverting the band.

validation.gold_why: Theta arguments give correct nonzero-inside-band region.
